## Validation and limitations

There were no user-supplied known articles. From PubMed pilot samples, 10 primary records were screened in and split before term mining:

- **Development:** 7/7 retrieved (100% relative recall; used to build the strategy).
- **Held-out validation:** 3/3 retrieved (100% relative recall; semi-independent because the records were discovered during this run).

These figures are relative recall against the screened records, not absolute sensitivity. No external benchmark set was assembled. The scope remains unconfirmed: I assumed farm animals include terrestrial livestock, poultry, horses, and farmed aquatic animals. Broad animal and sequencing headings may add screening work.
